title: Label sheet
summary: A grid of fixed physical cells for labels, bin tags and entry cards: set the cell size in mm, in or pt, a gap and the cells per row; each child is one cell and is never split across a printed page. Use it inside pk-print-page, whose size and margin define the sheet and which hides the app chrome. Cells show at true scale on screen.

props.name: cellWidth
props.description: Cell width: a number with mm, cm, in, pt or px. Anything else falls back to 50mm and warns once.

props.name: cellHeight
props.description: Cell height, same units. Falls back to 25mm.

props.name: columns
props.description: Cells per row; 0 fits as many as the width allows.

props.name: offsetX
props.description: Sheet origin from the left of its box, for pre-cut stock.

props.name: offsetY
props.description: Sheet origin from the top of its box, for pre-cut stock.

props.name: outline
props.description: Dashed cut guides around every cell, on screen and in print.

slots.description: The cells: one element per label (a pk-card, a div with an SVG barcode). A child larger than its cell is clipped and marked data-clipped.

writes.why: A flag only: set while a cell's content is larger than the cell and clipped, so a page or test can find the label that does not fit. Nothing else on a cell is written.

a11y: Adds no semantics: the cells keep their own roles and text. Colours and fills print (print-color-adjust: exact).
